 1 | Anticipate Missile | 1 missile | - | 100' | U
 2 | Anticipate Blow | 1 attack | - | 10' | U

17 | Dream III | caster | sleep | self | I

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster is aware of any missiles being fired at him this round. If the caster
is currently capable of moving, he gets a special bonus of +50 to his DB
against the missile attack of his choice. It is assumed that the caster moves
at least slightly to attempt to avoid the attack.
@@ 2
As Anticipate Missile, except applies to melee attacks.
@@ 3
When faced with a choice about which he has little or no information (e.g.,
which corridor leads outside the quickest) the caster may cast this spell and
the Gamemaster will determine which way he goes, biasing the choice favorable
by 25% (e.g, roll 1-100: correct on 26-100, incorrect on 01-25).
@@ 4
As Anticipate Missile, except applies to spell attacks. Caster gets a special
bonus of +50 to his DB against a directed elemental attack; or +20 against an
area elemental attack; or a basic spell attack suffers a special penalty of
-10.
@@ 5
Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if he
takes a specified action.
@@ 6
Caster is aware of any being within the area of effect that has hostile
intentions towards him. The hostility must be directed specifically at the
caster or the spell reveals nothing. The being’s hostility must be active
(i.e., driving the being to perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e.,
hate exists, but no action is planned).
@@ 8
Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. This
spell can only be used once per night. The caster must sleep a minimum of one
normal sleep cycle.
@@ 9
Caster has a vision of what has occurred in a room or place; limited to up to
1 minute per level into the past. The size of the room is limited to the area
of effect.
@@ 10
Predicts most probable actions of a being (the target) in the next round;
specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no detail
on attack target or what spell). This results in the caster being able to
declare his statement of intent for the round after hearing what the target
has decided to do. Note that the target is free to change his declared action
with the requisite penalties.
@@ 11
As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 2 minutes into the future.
@@ 12
As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 hour per level.
@@ 13
As Anticipate Hostility, except for area of effect, duration and range.
@@ 14
As Dream I, except limit is 2 dreams/night on different topics.
@@ 15
As Anticipations, except if action is to cast a spell, the spell to be cast
and target are learned.
@@ 16
As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 day per level.
@@ 17
As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams/night on different topics.
@@ 19
As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 week per level.
@@ 20
As Intuitions I, except time limit extends 1 minute per level into the future.
@@ 25
As Anticipations, except caster can predict actions of all beings within 100'
of him.
@@ 30
As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams/night on any combination of topics the
caster chooses.
@@ 50
As Anticipations True, except spell types and targets are learned.
